title: String Theory Alternative: The Complete Dual-Universe Cosmology with Dark Energy from Inverse Black Stars
summary: We present a complete alternative to string theory: a symmetric Dual-Universe Cosmology where black holes in our universe are white fountains in an inverse universe. We formalize the reciprocal feedback mechanism between universes, deriving Dark Energy as the injected flux from inverse universe black stars — eliminating the need for a cosmological constant. A modified Friedmann equation shows that the accelerating expansion of our universe is driven by the energy consumed by black stars in the inverse universe. The model requires no extra dimensions and no fine-tuning.

review.reason: Dual-universe cosmology model attributing dark energy to inverse-universe black stars.
